name: shipping-estimator
title: Shipping estimator
description: Country and postcode in, delivery options out: the cart's shipping estimator with prices, arrival windows and a postcode check per country.
docs: onEstimate gets a country and a postcode that already match the country's format, and returns the options: an empty list means you do not ship there, a rejection shows a retry message. Amounts are in minor units. Pass onSelect and the list becomes a radio group; it is called with null when the choice no longer stands (the country or postcode was edited, or a new estimate started), so clear whatever you stored. Pass defaultOptions to restore an earlier estimate. postcodes.ts exports the format rules, so the same check can run on your server.
